basic_info.description: Discover the charm and potential of 1882 26th Avenue, a delightful 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom single family home in San Francisco's highly sought after Central Sunset neighborhood. Just seconds from the serene Sunset Reservoir and the vibrant shops, restaurants, and public transit options along Noriega Street, this home offers the perfect blend of convenience and classic San Francisco living. Step inside to find a warm and inviting space featuring a well-lit living room with hardwood floors and a corner fireplace. The functional kitchen has immaculate original features and a skylight ready for your personal touch. Two comfortable bedrooms feature fresh paint, hardwood floors, and upgraded windows. But the true highlight of this property is its expansive garage, an incredible opportunity for expansion. Whether you dream of adding an additional bedroom and bathroom, creating a workshop, or designing extra living space tailored to your needs, the possibilities are endless. With its prime location near scenic parks, desirable schools, and the Pacific Oceans refreshing breezes, this home is an outstanding opportunity for homeowners and investors alike. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Central Sunset charm with unlimited potential.
